experiment_data.hypothesis: Full OCC BN on libero_object benchmark (seed 42): Tests whether gradient flow damage from OCC head (observed on libero_spatial) replicates on libero_object. If Full OCC BN CAR < Vanilla on object suite, strengthens cross-benchmark generalizability of the gradient flow finding.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate occsafe && cd /root/occsafe_vla/openvla-oft && WANDB_MODE=disabled torchrun --standalone --nnodes 1 --nproc-per-node 1 vla-scripts/finetune.py --vla_path /root/autodl-tmp/models/openvla-7b --data_root_dir /root/autodl-tmp/data/modified_libero_rlds/ --dataset_name libero_object_no_noops --use_l1_regression True --use_diffusion False --use_film False --num_images_in_input 2 --use_proprio True --batch_size 8 --learning_rate 5e-4 --num_steps_before_decay 100000 --max_steps 50005 --save_freq 5000 --image_aug True --lora_rank 32 --run_root_dir /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/full_occ_bn_object_s0 --run_id_note full_occ_bn_object_s0 --seed 42 --use_occ_head True --occ_detach False --occ_norm_type bn"
